prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 evening living-space portrait of one original approved adult woman with long dark-brown hair and blunt bangs, natural skin texture, soft makeup and a calm direct gaze. She wears the supplied pale pink or white lace bra and matching lace bottoms, nude thigh-high stockings with a wide lace top band and simple rings. Seat her sideways on a beige fabric sofa, with the left leg tucked onto the cushions and the right leg extended over the sofa edge toward the white marble floor, torso turned toward camera, left arm resting on the sofa back and right hand relaxed near the thigh. Include a cream wall with decorative molding panels and a warm-toned wall lamp lit above and behind her. Use a soft golden lamp glow, gentle highlights on hair and shoulders, soft defining interior shadows, sharp natural skin, lace and stocking texture, high-end digital photography and quiet luxurious evening atmosphere.
